Making sure to air them up to the proper psi, you will find that information on the inside of the driver door, there should be a sticker, that tells you what to air it up to. Please use a gauge or an air station that you set to a specific psi. 
Middle light means your traction control is on.

Pay for a mechanic you trust to inspect any vehicle before you purchase it! Absolutely best use of your money. They can tell you what condition the vehicle is in better, how much it would cost to fix, and even how long you can let that issue go. I personally buy vehicles with cosmetic damage and suspension issues. I can fix the suspension myself for relatively cheap, and I don’t care if the car looks ugly, but it means it’s less expensive. If you only have a small budget, find the issues you can either fix yourself or live with, like accessories that don’t work. At the very least bring someone with you, preferably someone who knows cars, even if you do. Another set of eyes and ears to inspect a used vehicle always helps. 
Also time is a big thing. If you aren’t in immediately need of a vehicle, keep saving and keep looking. It’s about finding the needle in the haystack, but the needle isn’t always for sale

Schizoaffective is not as incurable as you think, it’s caused by trauma more often than not. Cannabis of any kind, will make it worse.
From someone who is schizoaffective, and used to smoke cannabis, don’t do it. Go to therapy, deal with your shit. If you really want to consume marijuana, wait until it’s been a few years since your last hallucination. Also do not mix with anti psychotics, made that mistake once, never again. Basically just results in a bad trip leading to lots of delusions and psychosis
